responsibility: This header provides the text-art module’s foundational types and lightweight infrastructure. It defines strongly typed geometry templates for sizes, coordinates, ranges, rectangles, and 2D arrays; the style, style_manager, styled_unichar, and styled_string core data models used to represent styled renderable text; alignment enums; and the directions bitset used by line-art generation, making it the common base layer shared by canvases, tables, widgets, rulers, and themes.
